content.text:
I submitted index 109 (Ca 0.19, Co 0.18, Mn 0.63) as the best composition. The merit here is photocurrent under 2.06 eV light. I used all 3 measurements; each probed a different region of the library:

| Index | Composition | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | Co-rich (Co 0.70) | 1e-8 A |
| **109** | **Mn-rich (Mn 0.63)** | **5e-8 A** |
| 115 | Ca-rich (Ca 0.46) | −3e-8 A (no photoanode response) |

All three values are tiny, so the ranking is weak evidence. With only 3 measurements across 183 compositions, a better one could easily be among those I didn't measure. The Mn-rich area near index 109 looks most promising.

- **Third measurement:** the model-based suggestion tool pointed to more Mn-rich neighbours of 109 (such as 129 or 119), but it had only two data points to go on. I spent the last measurement on the untested Ca-rich region instead, and it came back negative.
- **XRD not used:** I ran no XRD, so the crystal phases behind these results are unknown. I also didn't review the known-phases list, because its output was too large and was saved to a file I didn't read.
